component.name: Schemaic
component.summary: Fast, native SQL editor for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite

description.p: Schemaic is a native SQL editor built to feel instant: a GPU-rendered interface that scrolls 200k-row result sets smoothly, an editable results grid, visual schema editing, and completion and diagnostics that follow the dialect you are actually connected to.

ul.li: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite, direct or over an SSH tunnel
Editable results grid, with writes wrapped in a transaction that rolls back unless exactly one row changed
Visual schema editing, with the generated ALTER or DROP always shown as SQL before it runs
Schema browser, ER diagrams, query history, EXPLAIN plans and a global schema search
CSV, TSV and JSON import with a full validation pass before a single row is written
An embedded terminal, and a one-click client session against the active connection
No account, no telemetry, no cloud service; credentials go to the OS keyring

description.p: Schemaic is in active development and should not be trusted with production data, or any data you care about.
